title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G launches in Singapore with MediaTek Helio G99+ - news.lavx.hu
text:
Samsung Galaxy A18 4G launches in Singapore with MediaTek Helio G99+ | LavX News Skip to content LavX News Open Source Open Source Security Open Source Apps Open Source Infrastructure Open Source AI Open Source Dev Tools Trends Regulation Business Startups Hardware Chips Laptops Smartphones Cloud DevOps Serverless Infrastructure Security Vulnerabilities Privacy Cybersecurity Dev Python Rust Mobile Backend Frontend AI Robotics LLMs Machine Learning Bookmarks Sign In English Sign In # Smartphones Samsung Galaxy A18 4G launches in Singapore with MediaTek Helio G99+
 Nov 14, 2026, 9:35 AM UTC • Sofia Ricci • 1 min read Share this article Save Advertisement Advertise on LavX News See options Samsung's Galaxy A18 4G is on sale in Singapore with MediaTek's Helio G99+ instead of the Exynos 1610 used in Europe. The 128 GB model costs SGD328, with launch discounts and a free charger offer running through Dec. 8, 2026.
 Samsung's Galaxy A18 4G is on sale in Singapore, and the local version swaps the Exynos 1610 chip used in Europe for MediaTek's Helio G99+. The two versions share the rest of the hardware.
 The phone has a 6.7-inch 90 Hz FullHD+ Super AMOLED display, a 5,000 mAh battery, 25 W charging, an IP64 rating, and a side-mounted fingerprint scanner. Cameras include a 13 MP selfie unit and a rear triple camera with a 50 MP primary, a 5 MP ultrawide, and a 2 MP macro. It runs Android 17-based One UI 9.
 Memory is 4 GB RAM. Singapore units ship with 128 GB storage, while other configurations can reach 256 GB. Storage expands up to 2 TB through a microSD card.
 The Galaxy A18 4G costs SGD328 (USD255, EUR230, INR24,025) in Singapore and comes in Black, Light Blue, and Silver. Samsung sells it through its Singapore website, Samsung Experience Stores, the Samsung Shop App, Lazada, Shopee, and major consumer electronics and IT stores. Retail listings show the 128 GB model at EUR213.93 and GBP189.99, and the 256 GB model at EUR301.77.
 Buyers who purchase from Samsung's official website, Samsung Experience Stores, the Samsung Shop App, or consumer electronics and IT stores receive an instant SGD30 discount. Buyers at Samsung Experience Stores or consumer electronics and IT stores receive a free 25 W power adapter without a cable, valued at SGD38. Both offers run through Dec. 8, 2026.
 A review of the Exynos model covers the shared hardware; performance will differ on the Helio model. The original announcement is available here .
 Source : Samsung Galaxy A18 4G launched in Singapore, but with a different chip , by Sagar , GSMArena.com , Nov 14, 2026

 Honor Magic10 series rumors point to 200MP LOFIC camera and dual-layer OLED display
 Tipster Smart Pikachu claims the Honor Magic10 series may feature a 200MP primary camera with LOFIC technology and a dual-layer OLED display. The display upgrade may remain limited, as the tipster ruled out dual-layer OLED panels for every flagship phone in 2027.
 Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra and Z Fold8 go on sale as Nothing Phone (3) gets a price cut
 Early Black Friday discounts cut hundreds of dollars from Samsung's Galaxy S26 Ultra, Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, while the Nothing Phone (3) drops to $500. Smaller cuts reach the Galaxy S26 FE, Galaxy S25 FE and Nothing audio gear.
 OnePlus 16 India launch may depend on Oppo Find X10 sales
 A tipster says OnePlus is preparing the OnePlus 16 for India, but the company may wait for Oppo Find X10 sales data before deciding. The phone launched in China in October with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip and a 9,000 mAh battery.
